help.title: About stock transfers
help.overview: Move goods from one warehouse to another. A transfer stays a draft until you complete it; then all its items move at once.

sections.title: Each transfer
items: Choose two different warehouses, then the products and quantities. Bundles can't be moved; move their parts.
Only a draft can be edited, completed or cancelled.
Complete transfer moves every line, or nothing if one line is short. Goods reserved for orders never move.
If the destination never stocked a product, its stock row is created.
A completed transfer can't be undone or deleted: make a transfer the other way instead. Its moves show in Stock movements.
